The experience taught Max more than any book could. Max keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. At first, Max found it difficult to keep the habit. What's more, mum is frying eggs in the kitchen.

On Sunday evenings, Max reviews the notes from class. The weekend breakfast looked quieter than usual that evening. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The interior walls are painted clay white.
Max prefers sunny weather when running in the cinema. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Little by little, things began to change. The fiscal year ends in March.
The family chat has become an important part of daily life. Max wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Also, there is a picture on the wall.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Max plans to study history harder this term. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
